heroCredit.text: Longjing tea district in Hangzhou, photographed by Niklas Dougherty on 20 October 2017. Homeground centre-cropped the photograph to 16:10, resized it and converted it to WebP. It identifies houses and tea fields within the wider Longjing district, not the administrative boundary of Longjing Village, and does not prove current harvest activity, public path access, tea origin, business quality or weather.
